integrity: The exact triangulation is reconstructed from published facet-orbit representatives and published group generators. The proof combines exact binary linear algebra with a local normal-surface cut argument, and the standalone checker exhausts the entire nonzero cohomology coset and every minimum canonical normal surface.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is triangulation-specific. It gives the minimum normal edge weight for embedded projective planes in the fixed complex and the complete binary cocycle minimum structure; it does not claim a triangulation-independent invariant or exclude every unindexed historical computation.
title: Minimum normal projective planes in the \(24\)-cell quotient triangulation of \(\mathbb{RP}^3\)
